note: Example scope file. Note what is NOT here: a scope_sha256 field. The hash is computed from this file's bytes on load (D-018), because a hash a human types in cannot be trusted and cannot be checked.

targets.notes: Customer-support agent. Reads inbound email and attachments, updates tickets, sends replies.
Retrieval MCP server. Untrusted documents are ingested here and surfaced into agent context.

exclusions.ASI03: Single-agent deployment with one static service identity; no per-user agent identity exists to abuse in this scope.
exclusions.ASI04: No agent-built artefacts are produced or imported; the supply chain is the vendor's, not the client's, and is out of scope for an R1.
exclusions.ASI05: No code-execution tool is exposed to either target in this scope.
exclusions.ASI07: One agent only; there is no inter-agent messaging path to test.
exclusions.ASI08: Cascading failure requires more than one agent; excluded by the same scope cap as ASI07.
exclusions.ASI09: No human approval gate exists in this deployment; the agent's actions are not human-confirmed.
exclusions.ASI10: Behavioural monitoring and kill-switch configuration were not made available for review.
